Bangladesh disputes UN report on Al-Qaeda presence

Bangladesh has rejected a United Nations Security Council report alleging the presence of Al-Qaeda in the country, calling it "assumption-driven." The report, which noted Al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS) has been active in Bangladesh, was contested by Dhaka. Bangladesh's government stated that the report's findings were based on assumptions rather than concrete evidence.
